dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're not from around here, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: You have a sharp eye. I'm from Liyue, and currently working here part-time while I prepare for an exam.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Ever since I was a kid, I've loved watching the ships come in and out of Liyue Harbor and seeing how they dock and load and unload their cargo...

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Over time, I grew fascinated with all sorts of ships. I'm hoping I can go to the Akademiya for further technical training.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: When I'm not working, I'll discuss questions I have about ships with the researchers and students I've met at work.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: At first, I felt bad about bothering them during their free time. I didn't realize how much the Akademiya students enjoyed talking with me!

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: There's an old expression in Liyue that says it best: Where there's a will, there's a way. I'll definitely pass the Akademiya exam!
